name: FeaturedTool

sources.title: Homepage — 'curated list of the best online tools' with Submit nav link
Pricing — free (180+ day queue), $9.9 listing, $19.9 featured

conditions: Free plan requires signing in (the site exposes a Sign In flow; submit is gated)
Free submissions join a queue with a stated '180+ days wait at current pace'
Free listings 'may be rejected due to limited free slots'
Free plan grants a permanent link only 'with backlink maintenance' — a reciprocal backlink appears to be required to keep it
requirements: Online tool/website to list; directory is general-purpose (3D, AI, Business, Productivity, Development, Design, etc.)
Account sign-in before the submission form is reachable
Free tier advertises '3 dofollow links' — category/tag choices affect link count
preparation: Category and tag selections from the site taxonomy
A backlink placement plan if using the free tier (backlink maintenance clause)
workflow: Choose plan: free (queue) / $9.9 listing (instant) / $19.9 featured (instant + 7 days top placement)
Complete the submission form in the signed-in area
Free route: wait in queue (180+ days stated); paid route: immediate publication
watchFor: The submit form sits behind authentication — field list not publicly visible
Free tier warns of 180+ day wait and possible rejection; $9.9 buys instant publishing
'Backlink maintenance' on the free plan implies an ongoing reciprocal-link requirement
Same operator/template as 600.tools and dirs.cc (shared @blankwebdev X handle) — identical pricing structure
countsAsLive: Product has a public item page at featuredtool.com/item/<slug> appearing in category/tag listings
unknowns: Exact fields on the authenticated submission form
Whether the free tier formally requires a reciprocal backlink
Rejection criteria and notification process for free submissions
